name: strata-v100x1
description: Strata cold matrix on one V100-32G (cuda12 engine): 1k/4k/16k/64k at C1/2/4.
caveats: Only contexts 1024/4096/16384/65536 are legal on V100; never reuse the L40 131k cell.
Volta nodes are shared: volta01 1x16GB, volta02/03 2x16GB, volta05 4x32GB. Pick a card that fits the pack and set --mem.
The 2026-10-25 run had 65536 cells rejected client-side (HTTP 400) before probe calibration; the current probe clamps and records the real prompt size.
The cuda12 engine is selected automatically on sm_70; do not force cuda13.
volta04 has been DOWN since 2026-09-07 (reboot timed out).
